description: Archive a review agent. Archive a review agent: it stops running and its key is free to reuse. Evals it already submitted stay on their trails.

agentId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: ops_review_agents_archive
